text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, I can even see the wood grain clearly 
now! This glasses cleaner is wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Right? I bought a whole box online, so 
I'll share some with ya.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Please finish it off with some anti-fog 
spray! I happen to have brought the exact 
one Royce-san recommended to me.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
*rub-rub*... Fufu. The glasses wipe Rob 
Roy recommended to me has become a 
favorite of mine as well.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, all set! Clear visibility. This 
should boost the time efficiency of my 
analysis even more!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I'll have to share this with Ikuno-san 
and the others next time. —After all, a 
friend with glasses is a friend indeed♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Royce and Royce seemed to have spent a 
very fulfilling day off.
